description: This file defines comparison utilities for etcd clientv3, including comparison types, functions to create comparison objects, and methods to manipulate comparison parameters.

classes.name: Cmp
classes.description: Comparison object used in etcd client operations.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Creates a comparison object based on the provided comparison type, result string, and value.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Creates a comparison object for a key's value.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Creates a comparison object for a key's version.

methods.name: CreateRevision
methods.description: Creates a comparison object for a key's creation revision.

methods.name: ModRevision
methods.description: Creates a comparison object for a key's modification revision.

methods.name: LeaseValue
methods.description: Creates a comparison object for a key's lease ID.

methods.name: KeyBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte slice of the comparison key.

methods.name: WithKeyBytes
methods.description: Sets the byte slice for the comparison key.

methods.name: ValueBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte slice of the comparison value, if any.

methods.name: WithValueBytes
methods.description: Sets the byte slice for the comparison's value.

methods.name: WithRange
methods.description: Sets the comparison to scan the range [key, end).

methods.name: WithPrefix
methods.description: Sets the comparison to scan all keys with the prefix.
